provenance.note: Revolvers with a barrel up to 4.25 in and pistols that fit the 220 x 140 x 40 mm box (C.7C.1). The course runs at 20, 15, 10 and 7 m on one or two NPA faces, the book does not say who chooses. The record holds the longest distance.
